sentences.en: The unprecedented drought did severe damage to the wheat harvest.
sentences.zh: 这场前所未有的旱灾严重损害了小麦的收获。

sentences.en: The spell of drought did severe damage to the harvest.
sentences.zh: 这段干旱期对农作物的收成造成了严重的破坏。

sentences.en: A poor rice harvest will get us into real trouble.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的大米收成就会给我们带来真正的麻烦。

senses.zh: 收获(期)，成果，收获物，收成
